description: Create the initial inventory, movement, backup, import, and settings schema.
Add query indexes, case-insensitive SKU uniqueness, and default settings.
Add analytics settings, financial fields, suppliers, batches, expiration tracking, and demonstration-data flags.

Finalize version 1.0 by removing legacy supplier and batch data and adding durable cloud-backup jobs.
